subject: Security Report Distribution List.
originalBody:
CLASSIFICATION: UNCLASSIFIED

Good morning,

I understand that your work covers DRC. Would it be useful to be included on a security report distribution list (no cost)?
We produce it monthly in English and French. We can happily send you over the mos
draftBody:
Dear Annette,

Thank you for reaching out to the Panzi Foundation and for thinking of us. We appreciate you sharing information about your security report distribution list — given our work in eastern DRC, this could indeed be of interest to our team.

We have forwarded your message internally for review, and the most relevant colleague will be in touch with you directly if they would like to be added to the list or receive a recent copy.

Thank you again for your kind offer, and for the work your organization is doing.

Warm regards,
The Panzi Foundation Team
